chapter: Entertainers, Creole Serenaders and La Vida
title: Going back to La Vida with Handy, about eight years
summary: After the Entertainers he joined Handy at La Vida. Several band changes and a switch to a nightclub marked the roughly eight years there.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Anyway we left off at the Entertainers, and then what happened after the Entertainers, after you played at the Entertainers? Is that the time when you got in with Peter Bocard? Oh, I see.
The years of that, I think I went with, uh, started preparing a little jobs in between, then I went with Handy, I think Handy hired me then. Went to La Vida?
Yeah, for La Vida, yeah. I started playing with Handy.
You went back to La Vida again.
Now what happened with Handy then? Well, uh.
I mean, they had Paul Barnes and Handy, they didn't have him at the same time. No, Paul Barnes was there before Handy.

I see. Did Handy take over the job, you think? Yes, Handy, I think, uh, Handy comes after Paul, I think. I see. I just wondered if they had a humbug, if he got sick, or what? See, at the time they had, uh, I think, uh, she was playing trumpet then. I think Isaiah Morgan was playing trumpet at that time. Paul Barnes, Sidney Fowler, and the ! He was playing trumpet then. I think Isaiah Morgan was playing trumpet at that time. Paul Barnes, Sidney Fowler, and the ! Flosie, and Davis on drum. That was that set up. And then they had some kind of humbug, you see. And that's when, uh, this other set come in. With Handy. Yeah. And you played in that band too? My favorite Handy, yeah. Handy was, uh, Howard. He handled Howard, Sidney Fowler, and Davis on drum. Was it almost the same thing? It was almost the same thing. It was just, uh, I don't know, they had some kind of humbug and snorts in the band.
So you stayed there for a while with Handy? Yeah, I stayed at the Levitas, with about eight years. Eight years?
Yeah, almost. With different bands and it's changed a little bit. Well, Handy stayed the longest. Oh, yeah?
Yeah, because the man was about to lose, the business was getting bad, you see.
And he was getting bad, you see. And he was getting bad, you see.
And he was getting bad, you see.
And he was getting bad. And then he changed it from a taxi dance into a nightclub. I see. So you played at that too? Yeah, a little nightclub they had there. It didn't last too long.
What was it called then? Was that called the V-Dine nightclub too?
It didn't last too long. It didn't last too long. It didn't last too long.
It didn't last too long. It didn't last too long. It didn't last too long.
I don't know how long it lasted, but it wasn't very long. And right after that I started to wait for the final nightclub. So you were eight years all together?
All together, yeah. With that kid Howard and with Handy, you know, this little fella.
Two different bands.
Yeah, two different bands.
